research_question: To evaluate the effectiveness of the '+Biodiversity@CIÊNCIAS' citizen science project for monitoring urban biodiversity on a university campus, and analyze which specific taxonomic groups experienced the most significant growth in species discovery.

phase_1.user_prompt: Our faculty runs a campus biodiversity project on the Portuguese node of iNaturalist and we now want to pull every observation belonging to the six groups we are reporting on: spiders and their kin, mushrooms and moulds, insects, mammals, snails and slugs and their relatives, and plants. Give me the iNaturalist iconic-taxon names for those six groups so we can scope the query.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have the list of taxa (Arachnida, Fungi, Insecta, Mammalia, Mollusca, and Plantae), please retrieve all the iNaturalist observations for these groups from the '+Biodiversity@CIÊNCIAS' project. Get all records from the start of the project on September 1, 2020, through the end of their study period on December 31, 2022, including both validated and non-validated data.
